latestVersion.changelog:
Xiaoyuzhou (小宇宙) podcast support added and subtitle workflows introduced.

- Added support for capturing 小宇宙（Xiaoyuzhou）podcast links, including parsing of shared text and extracting/using URL timestamps.
- Implemented subtitle download, parsing, and time window filtering for Xiaoyuzhou episodes with available SRT/VTT.
- Workflows for Xiaoyuzhou now include:
  - Subtitle availability checks, download, and parsing.
  - Deep summary generation based on user-specified time point windows or full transcript.
  - User-facing notifications if subtitles are unavailable or ASR is not configured.
- Updated supported platform list and documentation to reflect Xiaoyuzhou integration.
- Added corresponding scripts (xiaoyuzhou.ts and test-xiaoyuzhou.ts) for new platform handling.
